description: This file defines a TaskRunner class for managing and executing asynchronous tasks with support for setup, teardown, error handling, and timeout management within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TaskRunner
classes.description: Manages a sequence of tasks with setup and teardown phases, handling errors, interruptions, and timeouts.

classes.name: TimeoutWatcher
classes.description: Watches for timeout expiration during task execution.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the task list.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all tasks and performs cleanup, returning the final status.

methods.name: runDeferCleanup
methods.description: Runs tasks with deferred cleanup, handling signals, timeouts, and errors.
